posted.body: Addressed in `f8bae764`. Removed the stale `_AWS_SYNC = _aws(...)` assignment. The storage module now imports the AWS rules/specs from `command_storage_aws_s3` and includes them in the aggregate catalog; it has no `_aws` reference. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/runtime/command_storage_extensions.py#L7).

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Kept one `focusVisibleDashboardSearch` implementation alongside the dashboard navigation helper. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/dashboard/src/app.tsx#L118). The [dashboard CI job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35377269052/job/105704788672) for this PR head passed Vite production build and four browser checks on merge `975967f4`.

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Restored the `PresentationModeProvider` import; the root render still wraps `App` with that provider. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/dashboard/src/main.tsx#L5). The [dashboard CI job](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/actions/runs/35377269052/job/105704788672) for this PR head passed Vite production build and four browser checks on merge `975967f4`.

Addressed in `f8bae764`. The direct extension catalogs now include both Common CLI and repo2nb. Their rule tuples remain additive, so the repo2nb addition no longer replaces Vault/Cloudflare and the other Common CLI entries. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/runtime/command_builtin_extension_catalog.py#L52).

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Restored live explanation attachment for list, pending-summary, paginated, single-request, and next-pending reads. Summary projections retrieve the persisted action identity/envelope; Python and the retained frontend use the same domain-separated `act_` identity contract. Exact technical details remain withheld by default. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/store_approval_queries.py#L83).

Addressed in `f8bae764`. Extracted publication context resolution and verifier-key provisioning into `native_policy_snapshot_publisher_context.py`. The publisher is now 483 physical / 450 nonblank lines, and the extracted helper is 95 physical / 85 nonblank lines. [Published source](https://github.com/hashgraph-online/hol-guard/blob/f8bae76423f8120cb7c496f57407f7d47945f73d/src/codex_plugin_scanner/guard/native_policy_snapshot_publisher.py#L24).
